referencesConsulted.principle: Generate a local PMREM reflection environment once and dispose the demo scene; do not reuse the demo boxes as art.
Atmospheric sky shader was inspected, then replaced by controlled CanvasTexture gradients when its bright horizon washed out the title.
Use keyframed temporal states; adapt scene motions to absolute deterministic sampling for seeking and out-of-order review.
Manual inspection only; no auto-rotation is used for the scene camera.
Soft edges are restricted to soft furnishings; masonry, roof and cut surfaces remain planar.
Consulted for grounded silhouette and roof scale only; it does not approve this scene or its thermal layers.
Run local render and postprocessing steps in an explicit order; keep OutputPass last for renderer color and tone mapping.
Render the scene beauty pass before ambient occlusion, highlights, edge smoothing and output conversion.
Use ambient occlusion to strengthen contact between roof, insulation, room and furniture; this adaptation renders AO at 70% stage resolution.
Threshold highlights and keep bloom low to preserve material color and readable dark areas.
Reduce edge aliasing in linear-sRGB before OutputPass; SMAA area/search textures are embedded locally as data URIs.
Apply the existing, low-contrast vignette as a shader pass to guide focus without heavily darkening the edges.
Apply ACES tone mapping and SRGB output conversion once at the end of the composer.
Use hero-scale texture detail, mipmaps and anisotropic filtering within a GPU budget; upscaling alone does not invent surface detail.
Separate silhouette, surface and micro detail; add geometry where the model and camera need it, then profile triangle cost.
Keep renderer pixel ratio and postprocessing dimensions synchronized and budget high-density output deliberately.
A simple profile can use Shape-to-ExtrudeGeometry; adapted as a shallow fan blade with restrained bevel. The city example does not supply a fan design or presentation.
Extruding a silhouette provides controlled solid thickness; adapted to a thin, satin-neutral blade body. The architectural proportions/materials were not reused.
